profile.summary: TUCS Equipment Inc. is a company in Princeton, Minnesota that makes foodservice and food processing equipment. Its products include kettles, mixers, water bath tanks and bagging systems for cooking, chilling, packaging and handling food. It sells to commercial kitchens, including K-12 schools, and offers service, training and parts.
